learning.why: सर ने बार-बार diameter वाली symmetry समझाई, और अभी पिछली बार सुधार दिया तो याद आ गया कि answer अनंत है।
अभी सर ने ही बताया कि 4 or square type नहीं, बल्कि हर angle पे line होती है, तो ये misconception टूट गया।

end.summary:
- Practised reflection and rotation symmetry of a circle.
- Dev described repeated appearance during rotation but gave 2 or 4 lines of symmetry.
- Practised radius, chord, diameter, arc, segment, and sector.
- Dev repeatedly confused a sector with a segment; this was not corrected by the end.
- Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Dev practised circle symmetries and the names of its parts. They noticed that a circle looks the same after repeated rotations, but the idea of infinitely many lines of symmetry remained mixed up with 2 or 4 lines. Dev also mixed up a sector and a segment, and this was still present at the end. At home, use a paper circle: draw one centre-to-edge line, one chord, shade a sector like a pizza slice, and shade a segment between a chord and an arc; ask Dev to name each one.
